Author:     Boudhayan Bhattacharya <bbhtt.zn0i8@slmail.me>

    Bug 1908046 - Set the DICPATH environment variable. r=dandarnell
    
    
    This was set in runme.sh through bz#1882352 but it got lost when
    migrating to repack.sh in bz#1850043
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D216638

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
index fd51520aa56..2ad91abbe17 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-flatpak/repack.sh
@@ -167,6 +167,7 @@ flatpak build-finish build                                        \
         --socket=cups                                             \
         --require-version=0.10.3                                  \
         --persist=.thunderbird                                    \
+        --env=DICPATH=/usr/share/hunspell                         \
         --filesystem=xdg-download:rw                              \
         --filesystem=~/.gnupg                                     \
         --filesystem=xdg-run/gnupg:ro                             \
title: History 532: Bug 1908046 - Set the DICPATH environment variable. r=dandarnell
